tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search PriceInIndia for products sold in India and get matching listings with prices from retailers such as Amazon, Flipkart, Croma and Reliance Digital. Returns products (with price, MRP, discount, store, image and links) plus facet counts for brands, stores, categories and price buckets. Call this

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare prices across Indian retailers for a product query and return the cheapest available listing per retailer (Amazon, Flipkart, Croma, …), sorted by price. Note: this returns the cheapest listing per store for the query — not necessarily the identical SKU. Use after search_products or standalon

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List the product categories available on PriceInIndia (India), with ids and slugs. Use this to discover categories; then call list_category_products with a slug to see products.

tools.name: list_category_products
tools.description: List products in a PriceInIndia category (India) by slug, e.g. 'camera', 'laptops', 'mobile-phones'. Use browse_categories first to find the right slug. Then render_product_results to display the products as cards.

tools.name: render_product_results
tools.description: Display selected products as interactive product cards in the chat. Always call search_products, compare_prices, or list_category_products first, then pass those products here (unchanged). Do not invent or modify product data.
